steps.title: Take the case
steps.prompt: Run "Assign" to yourself: the case moves to IN_PROGRESS.

steps.title: Read the case
steps.prompt: Read all 4 of these fields of this investigation (every one is needed): "Case · Type and origin", "Case · Summary", "Case · Due date" and "Case · Status": type and origin, summary, due date and status.

steps.title: Read the alerts and hits
steps.prompt: Read both of these fields of this investigation (every one is needed): "Alerts and hits · Alerts" and "Alerts and hits · Screening hits": the alerts and screening hits behind the case, or how it was opened.

steps.title: Read the money flows
steps.prompt: Read all 3 of these fields of this investigation (every one is needed): "Transactions · Totals", "Transactions · Counterparties" and "Transactions · Countries": totals in and out over the period, who paid and who was paid, and the countries.

steps.title: Read the customer and their KYC
steps.prompt: Read all 5 of these fields of this investigation (every one is needed): "Customer · Profile", "Customer · Activity vs profile", "Customer · Accounts", "KYC · Status" and "KYC · Next review": what they declared against what came in, their accounts, their KYC status and next review.

steps.title: Read what was asked
steps.prompt: Read both of these fields of this investigation (every one is needed): "Requests · Open" and "Requests · Answers": questions still open, and the answers the customer gave.

steps.title: Need information from the customer?
steps.prompt: Ask when money came in that nothing on file explains and nobody asked yet. A full KYC review when the activity no longer fits the business itself. Never mention the investigation to the customer: tipping off is an offence.

steps.title: Ask the customer
steps.prompt: Run "Request information": the request is linked to the case, its wording reads like a routine check. The case waits for the answer, out of the analyst queue. The result card shows the request with its due date, and the case waiting for information.

steps.title: Request enhanced due diligence
steps.prompt: Run "Request enhanced due diligence": it opens a KYC review for the onboarding desk, or uses the one this case opened already. The case waits for it, out of the analyst queue. The result card shows the KYC review, and the case waiting for it.

steps.title: Proposed outcome
steps.prompt: File a SAR when the money flows show a pattern nobody explained (mule, scam proceeds). No SAR when the answers and the profile explain the activity. Exit when the customer will not document it, or the risk is outside our appetite.

steps.title: Draft the SAR
steps.prompt: Run "Draft SAR": it writes the report from the ticked transactions as a PDF and sends the case to the MLRO, out of the analyst queue.

steps.title: Read the draft SAR
steps.prompt: You are the MLRO. Read all 7 of these fields of this investigation (every one is needed): "Case · Type and origin", "Case · Summary", "Case · Due date", "Case · Status", "SAR · Draft", "SAR · Narrative" and "SAR · Filing": the case, then the draft: period, transactions, total and narrative.

steps.title: MLRO decision
steps.prompt: File it when the narrative and the transactions support the suspicion. Send it back when something is missing: say what in the reason.

steps.title: File the SAR with TRACFIN
steps.prompt: Run "File SAR": the report goes to TRACFIN through the ERMES portal and the case closes. Every account of the customer is frozen until TRACFIN answers (Ali's rule); the SAR waits in "Waiting for TRACFIN" for "Record TRACFIN answer". The result card shows the ERMES declaration number, the case closed and the accounts frozen.

steps.title: Send back to the analyst
steps.prompt: Run "Send back to the analyst" with what to add: the draft is discarded and the case goes back to the open investigations, where the analyst finds your reason in "Case · Status". The result card sums it up.

steps.title: Close without SAR
steps.prompt: Run "Close without SAR" with the reason. Needs the MLRO's approval (role setting). Accounts frozen for the suspicion are unfrozen. The result card shows the case closed with no SAR, and the accounts as they stand.

steps.title: Exit the relationship
steps.prompt: Run "Exit relationship": it opens a closure for the closure team (or refuses an onboarding not finished yet) and closes the case. The result card shows the case closed, and the closure opened or the onboarding refused.
